finding_key: docs/design/cli.md::new agent-facing error codes (`invalid_format`, `not_logged_in`) are not added to §10 error matrix, the canonical table agents/skills read for codes
evidence: Verified against the supplied `docs/design/cli.md`: the new §8.1 paragraphs (around lines 710-728) document `NOT_LOGGED_IN` (exit 1) and `INVALID_FORMAT`, but the §10 Error Matrix table later in the same file is untouched by the diff and still lists only TYPE_MISMATCH, INVALID_RANGE, CONFIRMATION_REQ, FILE_EXISTS, PATH_NOT_FOUND, UNAUTHORIZED, SYSTEM, YORKIE_ERROR, INVALID_DOCX, FONT_LOAD_ERROR. Both codes do exist in code (`formatter.ts` InvalidFormatError.code, `ctx.ts` NotLoggedInError.code) and reach agents via `outputError`, so the omission is real. Impact is doc-completeness only: the behavior is implemented and described in prose two sections earlier, so nothing is wrong or contradictory, just not enumerated in the canonical table.
